title: Publish queue row
description: The contract for one row of the 'MAKE - Publish Queue' tab. Agents may read every field. Make owns status, published_url, error and updated_at at publish time; nothing else may write them.

row_id.description: Stable row identity. Not the spreadsheet row number, which shifts when rows are inserted.

content_id.description: The source item. Two rows sharing content_id and platform are a duplicate risk.

pack_id.description: The distribution pack this row came from, so a post can be traced back to the decision that made it.

asset_ref.description: Empty on a media-required platform is a blocking defect, and detectable before the scheduled time.

target_url.description: The UTM-tagged link the post carries.

status.description: HOLD is a human decision and is NOT a failure. PROCESSING, SENDING and RETRY are transient — one of them, aged, means a run died mid-flight.

approved_by.description: The human who approved it. An agent name here is a defect.

published_url.description: Written by Make on success. PUBLISHED with this empty is unverifiable and is never counted as a success.

error.description: Verbatim from the platform. Never summarised — the exact text is what identifies the cause.

idempotency_key.description: content_id + platform + scheduled_at. The single defence against a duplicate publish on retry.

requires_media.description: Override for a platform not in the media-required list. null means fall back to the platform default.
